text: Residents have contacted me concerned about the safety on Laura Rd and Lomar Dr. Speeding is an issue in this neighbourhood as well as pedestrian safety while crossing. Staff have not yet conducted traffic counts however, given the precariousness of the situation, I am recommending the committee authorize an All-Way stop at this location.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Laura Road at Lomar Drive.
